description.value: Blend Bites is a quick-service cafe in West Kelowna offering bubble tea, smoothies, and sandwiches. The shop operates an online ordering portal through Clover, making it easy for cyclists to pre-order before arriving. It sits in a commercial unit on Dobbin Road, a corridor with several shops and services.

address.value: 2525 Dobbin Road Unit 1B, West Kelowna, BC V4T 2G1

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website URL resolves to Instagram, which returned only a login wall with no business-specific content — effectively unusable as a primary evidence source. All substantive information comes from OSM tags: amenity=cafe, cuisine=bubble_tea;smoothie;sandwich, and a website:menu tag pointing to a Clover online-ordering page, which strongly implies takeout service. No phone, washroom, bike parking, or Wi-Fi data is available from either source.
concerns: The listed website is an Instagram profile, which returned only a login wall — no business-specific content could be extracted. Most amenity fields remain unverified.
No phone number recorded in OSM or on the accessible website content.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, operating cafe with OSM presence and a live online-ordering menu; no indication of closure or inaccessibility.
enrichment_extras.notes: A secondary menu URL (https://www.clover.com/online-ordering/blend-bites-west-kelowna) is available in OSM as website:menu and may yield additional business detail if fetched directly.
